$comment: Generated by `mechframe catalog` from every built module's module.json (SPEC.md section 17). Don't edit by hand.

modules.name: Audio player
modules.summary: One player for the site's own audio: waveforms, a queue, one thing at a time, and plays counted with no personal data.
use_when: The site plays its own audio, such as albums, singles or readings, and another module hands the player what to play
Several players on one page, a YouTube player among them, must never play over each other
The team wants to know how often each track is played, without a cookie or a consent banner for it
avoid_when: The audio only lives on SoundCloud or Spotify and a provider's own player is enough: that's embeds
Music must keep playing while a visitor moves between pages: this player stops on a page move

modules.name: Blog
modules.summary: Dated posts in Markdown, with categories, scheduling, related posts and a cover from media or the AI.
use_when: The site publishes news, stories, poems or write-ups, each with a date, an author and a category
Posts are drafted and scheduled ahead, and a post's address may change while old links keep working
Each post needs a cover image for its card and for sharing, and a few related posts under it
avoid_when: The page is fixed, like About or Credits, and has no date or author: that's pages
The writing is a thread people start and answer: that's community
The posts are mailed out rather than read on the site: that's campaigns

modules.name: Newsletter
modules.summary: The site's newsletter: sign-ups confirmed by email, emails sent with one-click unsubscribe, bounces set aside.
use_when: People should be able to ask for the site's news and new releases by email, from a form on any page
The site's people write an email, test it on themselves, and send it now or at a set time to everyone who asked
A new blog post should go to the subscribers as soon as it's live
The site sends its own mail by SMTP or Resend and must keep its list clean of addresses that bounce or complain
avoid_when: Mail should be segmented, A/B tested or tracked by opens and clicks: that's a marketing platform's job
A person should hear about something they did, such as a reply to their comment: that's the kernel's notifications
Members talk to each other or to staff: that's a chat or community module

modules.name: Contact
modules.summary: The site's contact form, and an Inbox where its people read each message, reply from their own email and set spam aside.
use_when: Visitors should be able to write to the site's people without an account: bookings, press, commissions, questions
Each message should say what it's about, so it reaches the right person and the important ones come first
A bot's message should be set apart as spam, never reaching anyone and never silently lost
avoid_when: Members talk to each other or to staff in threads: that's a chat or community module
Each message should become a ticket with an owner, notes and replies sent from the site: that's a help desk
The form only takes an address for news: that's campaigns' sign-up

modules.name: Discography
modules.summary: Albums, EPs and singles with tracks, credits and streaming links; tracks play from an upload or a SoundCloud link.
use_when: The site belongs to an artist, band, label or collective that releases music
Releases and tracks need their own pages, credits, streaming links or an on-site player
Music is uploaded as masters, or already on SoundCloud, and should play on the site
avoid_when: Music is only linked out and never played on the site: that's embeds
The audio is a beat or sample for sale: that's licensing

modules.name: Embeds
modules.summary: YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify and Bandcamp players from a pasted link, loaded only once a visitor plays.
use_when: Writers put videos and tracks from YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify or Bandcamp in pages and posts by pasting a link
Nothing from those providers should load, or set its cookies, until a visitor chooses to play
A page plays a list of YouTube videos in one player, one after another
avoid_when: The site's own audio or video files are played, or previews must be tagged and the full file never reachable: that's audio-player and media
A video should be for members or buyers only: a provider's player can't keep it private
An admin chooses what plays in a homepage player: that list is featured's, which can use this module's playlist player

modules.name: Featured
modules.summary: Homepage players staff choose: ordered, schedulable lists of other modules' items or YouTube links.
use_when: The homepage or a page shows hand-picked items that staff reorder or schedule
Staff need to swap featured content on a date without a deploy
A page plays a list of YouTube videos that staff choose
avoid_when: The list is simply the newest items; query the module that owns them instead
Each item needs its own fields and pages; build it in its own module

modules.name: Media library
modules.summary: Images uploaded once with alt text, cleaned of metadata, and placed by any module.
use_when: The site's editors upload images for posts, pages, covers, member photos or product shots
More than one module on the site places images, and an image should be uploaded once and reused
Photos come from phones and cameras, so their location and camera details must be stripped before they're public
avoid_when: The site only shows audio, video or documents: media takes images only, so use the module that stores those
A single module keeps its own few images that nothing else places: storage.put in that module is enough

modules.name: Pages
modules.summary: The site's fixed pages, About to Privacy, written in Markdown and placed in the header's and footer's menus.
use_when: The site needs pages its people write and change themselves: About, Credits, Privacy, Terms, a press kit
Those pages belong in the site's header or footer menu, chosen page by page
A page's address may change, and links to the old one must keep working
avoid_when: The page is dated news or a story with an author and comments: that's a blog post
The page is laid out from designed sections and blocks: VybeSite's builder comes as pages' next version
The page is drawn from the site's own code and never changes: put it in the site's own pages

modules.name: Social
modules.summary: Shares a published post, release or product to the site's social channels through Buffer, from its own admin page.
use_when: The site's people should post a new blog post, release or product to the site's LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon accounts
One Buffer account already holds the site's channels, or can: Buffer posts to each network for it
Whoever shares should pick the channels, edit the words and choose when it goes out, and see how each post stands
avoid_when: Posts should go out by themselves whenever something publishes
A post needs a picture or a video of its own (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest): 0.1.0 posts links
The site wants likes, clicks and other numbers back from the networks
